headline: CAPSTONE COPPER EXITS COZAMIN TO LUCA MINING IN $385M DEAL — $275M CASH UPFRONT, COPPER PRICE EARNOUT UP TO $60M MORE
snippet: Capstone Copper Corp. has agreed to sell the 100%-owned Cozamin copper-silver-zinc-lead mine in Zacatecas, Mexico, to Luca Mining Corp. for up to $385 million: $275 million cash at closing, $15 million in Luca Mining shares, $35 million deferred, and up to $60 million in copper price earnout payments triggered at LME thresholds above $7/lb. Capstone is redirecting capital to its Mantoverde and Santo Domingo copper projects in Chile and the Pinto Valley copper mine in Arizona, exiting a high-cost polymetallic asset to concentrate on large, low-cost copper expansions — and Luca Mining, an emerging TSX-V polymetallic producer, becomes one of the largest junior mining companies in Mexico overnight.

headline: LARVOTTO FIRES FIRST GOLD-ANTIMONY CONCENTRATE AT HILLGROVE — GLENCORE AND WOGEN OFFTAKES LIVE AS AUSTRALIA'S LARGEST ANTIMONY PRODUCER COMES ONLINE
snippet: Larvotto Resources Ltd. produced its first antimony and gold concentrate at the Hillgrove mine in New South Wales on September 21, 2026, with flotation cells and concentrate filter presses fully commissioned on schedule and within the $73 million project budget. Hillgrove is designed to produce approximately 4,900 tonnes of antimony and 40,500 ounces of gold annually over an 8-year initial life — representing roughly 7% of global antimony supply from a non-Chinese source — with binding offtakes to Glencore for gold and Wogen Resources for antimony already in place, making this one of the most strategically significant new mining operations to come online in 2026.

headline: SILVERCO LA NEGRA PEA: $329M AFTER-TAX NPV ON $21M CAPEX — 131% IRR AT $50/OZ SILVER AS FLEET ARRIVES Q4
snippet: Silverco Mining Ltd. (TSXV: SICO) released an independent Preliminary Economic Assessment for its producing La Negra Mine in Durango, Mexico, showing an after-tax NPV of $329 million at a $50/oz silver base case — on initial capital of just $20.9 million and a 131% IRR over an 8.2-year mine life. The resource totals 98.2 million silver-equivalent ounces Indicated plus 12.6 million Inferred; at current spot near $67/oz, 34% above the PEA case, the economic leverage is substantial, and the company's new mining fleet is arriving in Q4 2026, with a dry-stack tailings upgrade expected to drive a meaningful throughput step-up in H1 2027.

headline: US TUNGSTEN DRILLING HIT: GUARDIAN METAL 92 METRES AT 0.34% WO3 AT NEVADA'S TEMPIUTE — UNDERGROUND REHAB STARTS OCTOBER
snippet: Guardian Metal Resources plc (LSE: GMET, OTCQB: GMTLF) reported Phase I and initial Phase II drilling results at the Tempiute tungsten project in Nevada, with multiple tungsten-rich zones confirmed beyond the historical mine footprint — including a 92-metre intersection at 0.34% WO3 — confirming the deposit's potential scale ahead of underground drill access. An underground mining contractor has been engaged to rehabilitate historical workings beginning in October 2026, at which point underground rigs will target the higher-grade South Thumb and Schofield zones; domestic US tungsten projects with drilling traction have attracted acute investor interest in 2026 given the near-total Chinese dominance of global tungsten supply.

headline: YTTRIUM TO US DOWN 75% — AEROSPACE TESTS DECADES-OLD TURBINE COATING FORMULAS AS CHINA CHOKES RARE EARTH SUPPLY
snippet: US yttrium shipments are down approximately 75% year-over-year in 2026, with China approving only 70 tonnes total since March — well below industrial requirements for yttria-stabilized zirconia, the dominant rare-earth-based thermal barrier coating that protects turbine blades in jet engines and power generators from extreme heat. Aerospace suppliers and research institutions including the NRC are now evaluating non-rare-earth zirconium dioxide formulas dating to the 1970s–1980s as substitutes, but experts say viable drop-in alternatives remain several years away, underscoring the strategic premium now attached to yttrium-bearing and other heavy rare earth deposits outside China.

headline: VENEZUELA'S 31 TONNES OF GOLD CLOSE TO LEAVING BANK OF ENGLAND — DEAL BEING FINALIZED FOR TRANSFER TO NEW YORK FED
snippet: Venezuela and the Bank of England are near agreement to transfer approximately 31 tonnes of gold — valued at roughly $4 billion at current prices — to the Federal Reserve Bank of New York as collateral for reconstruction borrowing after Venezuela's June 2026 earthquakes, potentially ending a seven-year freeze stemming from the country's political crisis. The deal faces one remaining obstacle: a UK court must still formally identify which Venezuelan authority may lawfully instruct the Bank of England, with the Bank withholding the gold pending that ruling; resolution would release a significant gold position into active circulation after nearly a decade frozen in London.

headline: EUROPE'S FIRST PERMITTED LITHIUM MINE HEADS TO NASDAQ IN $835M DEAL — CRITICAL METALS / EUROPEAN LITHIUM SCHEME BOOKLET DISPATCHED, VOTE OCTOBER 22
snippet: European Lithium Ltd. (ASX: EUR) dispatched its Scheme Booklet to securityholders this week following the Supreme Court of Western Australia's September 15 ruling clearing the $835 million all-stock merger with Critical Metals Corp. (Nasdaq: CRML), with shareholder and scheme votes now scheduled for October 22, 2026 in Perth. The deal — structured as 0.025 to 0.045 CRML shares per EUR share (minimum $8, maximum $16 implied value) — would bring the Wolfsberg Lithium Project in Carinthia, Austria to Nasdaq: the first fully permitted hard-rock lithium mine in Europe and a project designed to supply lithium hydroxide directly to battery manufacturers within the EU's own critical minerals supply chain.

headline: ATHABASCA BASIN URANIUM HUNT: TRACTION URANIUM ADVANCES AURORA TO FALL 2026 DRILL TESTING — VTEM CONDUCTORS AND RADIOMETRIC ANOMALIES TARGETED
snippet: Traction Uranium Corp. (TSXV: TRAC) will proceed with a fall 2026 diamond drill program at the Aurora Uranium Project in Saskatchewan's southeastern Athabasca Basin, testing priority conductive targets identified through a 2024 VTEM survey and a 2026 property-wide airborne radiometric and magnetic survey — with emphasis on conductors co-located with radiometric anomalies, the classic signature of unconformity-hosted uranium mineralization in the Basin. Aurora is operated by Cosa Resources Corp., with Traction earning up to an 80% interest by funding exploration — offering leverage to a Basin where uranium long-term contract prices just reached a nominal all-time high of $96.50/lb, and where any drill intersection near-unconformity immediately captures institutional attention.

headline: INDONESIA HALVES NICKEL ORE BENCHMARK — LOW-GRADE HPM CUT 45% AGAIN AS JAKARTA ALIGNS OFFICIAL PRICES WITH MARKET REALITY
snippet: Indonesia's Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources has revised the nickel ore benchmark price (HPM) for the second time this month, cutting the H2 September price for 1.2% Ni low-grade limonite ore to approximately $24.89 per wet metric tonne — a 45% reduction from the $44.97/wmt level set in late August — by slashing the nickel correction factor from 26% to 14% and cutting the cobalt coefficient. The reset reduces feedstock cost uncertainty for Indonesia's HPAL plants, which process low-grade ore into battery-grade nickel chemicals for the EV supply chain; Indonesian HPAL economics had been distorted since early 2026 because market prices had already fallen well below the old HPM, and the realignment matters for the competitive positioning of non-Indonesian battery metals projects globally.

headline: GOLD TECHNICAL: $4,307 SUPPORT HOLDS AFTER FED RATE HIKE — $4,430 CHANNEL RESISTANCE THE WEEK'S BULL TEST
snippet: RoboForex's weekly gold technical analysis for September 21–25 identifies $4,307 and $4,216 as the key support band following gold's sharp rebound from the $4,235 post-Fed-hike low, with immediate resistance at $4,367 — the level buyers must clear to confirm a short-term momentum shift — and the week's primary target at $4,430, the upper boundary of the horizontal channel that has contained gold for three weeks. A Hammer reversal pattern near the lower Bollinger Band on the H4 chart suggests near-term upside pressure; the decisive catalyst is Thursday's Trump-Xi summit, where a breakdown on critical minerals or Taiwan could spike gold above the channel while a cooperative outcome would likely fade the safe-haven bid toward lower support.
